category.name: Rendering
category.preferred_workflow: Load the source Document, optionally assign a FontSettings instance, create the appropriate SaveOptions subclass (e.g., ImageSaveOptions for TIFF), set only supported properties such as Resolution, TiffCompression, PixelFormat, PageSet, or PageSavingCallback, invoke Document.Save with the configured options, and finally verify that the output file exists.

strict_api_bans: Never reference members that are absent from Aspose.Words 26.11.0.
Do not invent namespaces, types, or properties that are not documented.
canonical_patterns: Use ImageSaveOptions.Resolution to specify DPI instead of a non-existent DesiredDpi property.
Select pixel formats via ImagePixelFormat (e.g., Format1bppIndexed) and set ImageSaveOptions.ImageColorMode for black-and-white output.
Control page range with ImageSaveOptions.PageSet rather than undefined PageIndex or PageCount properties.
nullable_warning_prevention: Validate only the creation of the expected output file and its basic properties.
Avoid inspecting unrelated document internals or performing extensive content checks.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: The compiler reports CS0117 or CS1061 errors because a referenced property or enum value does not exist.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Code was written against imagined members such as DesiredDpi, PixelFormat, TiffCompression.CcittGroup4, or SubstitutionSettings.Enabled that are not part of the current Aspose.Words version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace the invalid member with the documented alternative (e.g., use ImageSaveOptions.Resolution, ImagePixelFormat, TiffCompression.Lzw, or configure font substitution via reflection only when the property is present).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the official Aspose.Words API reference for the exact property names and supported enum values before coding.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0246 errors indicate that types like LoadOptions, FontSettings, or FontFallbackSettings cannot be found.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The source file omitted necessary using directives or referenced types that belong to a different assembly version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Add the appropriate using statements (e.g., Aspose.Words.Fonts) and ensure the project references the correct Aspose.Words package version.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always include the namespaces listed in the category's required_namespaces section when using related APIs.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Assuming external files or folders exist
common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime failures occur because the program tries to load a document, font folder, or XML file that was never created.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Examples presumed the presence of input assets without creating deterministic local samples.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Create sample input files, directories, or font collections programmatically before loading or processing them.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Bootstrap all required assets within the example code to make the sample self-contained.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: The program throws exceptions after successful rendering while checking unrelated document structures.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Validation logic examined internal nodes or properties that are irrelevant to the task.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Limit validation to the existence of the output file and, if needed, simple format-specific checks such as page count.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Keep verification narrow and directly related to the requested behavior.

narrative.overview: The Aspose.Words rendering category illustrates how to convert Word documents to TIFF and other image formats using the library's native APIs. Verified examples demonstrate correct use of ImageSaveOptions, font configuration, page selection, and batch processing without invoking unsupported members.
narrative.purpose: Guide an AI coding agent to produce dependable Aspose.Words rendering code that loads documents, applies documented save options, manages font settings, and writes the requested output while staying within the supported API surface.
validation_priorities: Ensure that the generated file exists and that its DPI, compression, and pixel format match the values configured in the save options.
maintenance_notes: Review the Aspose.Words release notes periodically and update examples when new properties are added or existing ones are deprecated.
Regenerate sample documents if the default content model changes in future versions.
